title: Portal
content: I’ve finally been able to get (somewhat) of an accurate picture of this. I often dream on this large tree like room with a small blue portal on the floor. I am the only one that is able to access this in my mall world for some reason. The few times I have gone through it , it takes me to a place that looks like I am on a very small platform overlooking the whole earth from space. There is always a strange ethereal entity there speaking to me but I can never remember what it says. Anyone else??? This one feels crazy but I know it’s connected to my mall world.
